guide.title: Alarak's Overview
guide.text:
Alarak is a melee Assassin who controls the battlefield by
manipulating the positioning of his enemies. He can sacrifice raw damage for
increased utility through Sadism, allowing him to
deal with each challenge differently. Telekinesis
allows him to push himself and enemies in any direction, while
Discord Strike can render them completely helpless
afterward. It is recommended to play him alongside tanks and
assassins. He excels at displacing enemies into
dangerous positions, enabling easy follow-ups from
teammates, securing takedowns. Reliably landing Discord Strike and Telekinesis
can be difficult, and requires practice. Putting in the time to get comfortable
with these Abilities is essential in leveraging his great potential.

guide.title: Alarak's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Can Silence enemies often by using Discord Strike
Can reposition enemies or himself with Telekinesis
Great potential to setup takedowns
Strong burst damage
Very high skill ceiling
Weaknesses
Poor waveclear
Cannot solo Mercenary Camps effectively
Discord Strike's delay and shape can make it a relatively difficult skillshot
Difficult to master

Alarak's Overwhelming Power Build shifts him from a burst Hero
towards a Bruiser playstyle, by enhancing his Basic Attacks,

crowd control. Differently
from the other builds, this one does not get Applied Force
at Level 7. Therefore, we do not recommend it against poke compositions
or against many Ranged Assassins, since you will have
a hard time hitting combos or delivering Basic Attacks towards them. Despite this
weakness, we find this build excellent when facing melee-heavy team compositions.
Alarak will be able to easily punish those melee Heroes, while also reducing their power
due to extra Silence or Slow provided by his Level 7 Talents.
Overwhelming Power empowers Basic Attacks and
encourages Alarak to be always delivering Basic Attacks after a combo. At Level 7,
Hindered Motion is the standard Talent, since it will enable
you to be constantly attacking the target, getting value from your Level 1 and 16's
Talents. However, if you already have a decent way to reduce your enemy's movements in your
team, like Jaina or Fenix provide, we recommend going for
Dissonance instead. Lethal Onslaught
at Level 16
will be excellent if you have a good amount of Sadism stacks,
because it will provide more damage and healing from your Basic Attacks, making it
easier to maintain your lead. However, Mocking Strikes will
be a great power spike in fights, since it will provide

The Lightning Surge Build is exceptionally good at long range poke, especially
against melee-heavy team compositions. Target enemy Heroes behind the enemy
frontline
whenever possible, to damage as many Heroes with each cast as possible. When
you finish stacking Extended Lightning, you will be able to slow
enemies who are hit by the center of the beam. Negatively Charged can
be stacked without limit, and is not lost on death. With
Hasty Bargain and clever positioning, you can
cast Lightning Surge up to 4 times in quick succession. It is very important to
focus on hitting enemy Heroes with the center of Lightning Surge's beam, as
many of your Talent investments involve this mechanic.
Unfortunately this build has poor early game, and is
very reliant on having many stacks from Extended Lightning.
For this reason, we only recommend going for it in scenarios where you will easily stack,
like in Tomb of the Spider Queen, Braxis Holdout or
Infernal Shrines.

guide.title: Alarak's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Alarak synergizes with
Alarak has terrible waveclear, but excels at displacing
enemies, while silencing them. Therefore, Assassins with decent
waveclear and good damage to follow his combo are
excellent with him, such as Jaina or Raynor. E.T.C. and
Garrosh are also decent with Alarak, since their displacement and
crowdcontrol are good for following his combo, or
to setup for it.
Alarak is countered by
Alarak is countered by crowd control.
Johanna and E.T.C. are a threat, since their stuns
will not allow Counter-Strike or Telekinesis
to be used, turning him into an easy kill. Medivh is also a nuisance, since his
Force of Will may protect against Discord Strike,
and Poly Bomb is a great follow up to kill you.
Deathwing can ignore Alarak, since he is constantly
unstoppable and will not be displaced or silenced.

guide.title: Alarak's Maps
guide.text:
Alarak's stronger maps
Alarak's average maps
Alarak's weaker maps
Alarak is not able to deal large amounts of
damage to non-Heroic entities during PvE encounters with his Abilities;
however, he can be effective during team fights that occur during map
objectives. He is better on maps that are oriented around team fighting,
rather than those that require strong Minion or Mercenary
clearing. Narrow choke points can help him land his Abilities on multiple
enemy Heroes at the same time.
Alarak is an excellent pick in Battlefield of Eternity, considering he can
use Telekinesis to displace enemies into Immortal stun.
Be aware this can be done in other maps as well, such as Hanamura Temple, or
Tomb of The Spider Queen. You can use it to Displace your enemies into Sentinel's
AoE slash, or towards Webweavers' Death Wave.

guide.title: Alarak's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Use Discord Strike to Silence and damage your enemies, leaving them vulnerable.
You can self cast Telekinesis to propel yourself forward, into the direction Alarak is facing. Use this to confirm a kill, or push yourself to safety.
Lightning Surge has low mana cost, and is a great way to recover small amounts of Health as needed. Always try to hit enemies with the center of its beam for extra damage.
Deadly Charge can be channeled for a small duration, allowing you to use it quickly in a teamfight, but still dealing all the damage. This is recommended to be done when enemies can easily punish you after you dive in, considering you will not lunge to the middle of enemy team by using it quickly.
Be aware that you will lose all your Sadism on death, so even though a game is looking easy, it can easily backfire if you lose your stacks. In many situations it might be better to just abandon allies in a bad situation, instead of trying to help them and risking your own life.
Make whatever choices will help you establish dominance; even if that means sacrificing some of Sadism's bonus damage for utility options.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Alarak's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Alarak works best on a team that can reliably follow up when he forces an enemy out
of position or silences them. Alarak forces enemies to respect his area of
influence, as getting too close can quickly result in death. His kit is
composed of powerful skillshots, which can be extremely
rewarding when combinations are executed flawlessly.
Alarak is stronger when close to his team, and should be played following them.
He is dependent on stacking his Sadism, and
Show of Force or Negatively Charged,
which is easier to be done against four possible targets, instead of one.

abilities.title: Alarak's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Use Discord Strike to Silence and damage your enemies, leaving them vulnerable.
You can self cast Telekinesis to propel yourself forward, into the direction Alarak is facing. Use this to confirm a kill, or push yourself to safety.
Lightning Surge has low mana cost, and is a great way to recover small amounts of Health as needed. Always try to hit enemies with the center of its beam for extra damage.
Deadly Charge can be channeled for a small duration, allowing you to use it quickly in a teamfight, but still dealing all the damage. This is recommended to be done when enemies can easily punish you after you dive in, considering you will not lunge to the middle of enemy team by using it quickly.
Be aware that you will lose all your Sadism on death, so even though a game is looking easy, it can easily backfire if you lose your stacks. In many situations it might be better to just abandon allies in a bad situation, instead of trying to help them and risking your own life.
Make whatever choices will help you establish dominance; even if that means sacrificing some of Sadism's bonus damage for utility options.

abilities.title: Sadism
abilities.text:
Sadism
(D)
Alarak
Passive
Alarak's Ability damage and self-healing are increased by 100% against enemy Heroes.
Repeatable Quest: Takedowns increase Sadism by 3%, up to 30%. Sadism gained from Takedowns is lost on death.
Alarak deals relatively low baseline damage with his Abilities when compared to
other Assassins. Sadism serves to bring his damage more in line with other
Assassins when using his Abilities on enemy Heroes, however, his non-Heroic
damage remains mediocre. This helps to define Alarak as an anti-Hero who should
focus on damaging and disabling enemy Heroes, rather than clearing lanes,
pushing, or clearing Mercenary Camps.

abilities.title: Discord Strike
abilities.text:
Discord Strike
(Q)
Alarak
Mana: 55
Cooldown: 8 seconds
After a 0.5 second delay, enemies in front of Alarak take 165 (+4% per level) damage and are silenced for 1.5 seconds.
Discord Strike is Alarak's primary tool for disabling enemy Heroes. Because
it requires a brief channel time, Discord Strike is best used in combination
with Telekinesis. It can also be used effectively as follow-up for crowd
control provided by team members. Sometimes enemies will be predictable, and
can be hit without the use of Telekinesis. This is preferable, as it leaves
Telekinesis open for securing kills or as an escape.

abilities.title: Telekinesis
abilities.text:
Telekinesis
(W)
Alarak
Mana: 30
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Create a force, pushing Alarak and all enemies hit from the targeted point towards the targeted direction. Deals 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.
Telekinesis should often be used to pull enemy Heroes into
Discord Strike. This is accomplished by casting
Telekinesis and immediately following it up with Discord Strike. Landing the
combo comfortably will take some practice, but it is important to
begin casting Discord Strike before the Telekinesis animation is complete. If
you wait to aim Discord Strike, your target will have time to move out of the
way. Telekinesis can be applied in a variety of other ways as well. It serves
as Alarak's escape, his only form of peel, and can be used to displace enemy
Heroes into dangerous places (such as Immortal's Stuns on Battlefield of Eternity)
or towards your Tank so they can crowd control
whoever has been caught that way and then you can follow up
with Discord Strike without risking a miss.

abilities.title: Lightning Surge
abilities.text:
Lightning Surge
(E)
Alarak
Mana: 25
Cooldown: 6 seconds
Deal 62 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy and an additional 100% damage to enemies between Alarak and the target. Restore 75 (+4% per level) health for each Hero hit.
Lightning Surge enables Alarak to poke most enemy Heroes from a safe
distance, and will also heal him for a flat amount for each Hero hit. Sadism
does modify this healing. If multiple enemy Heroes are struck by the beam, the
healing can become quite significant. Use Lightning Surge to harass enemy
Heroes whenever it is available. Remember that you can target enemy Minions and
Structures directly behind your intended targets, allowing you to get a little
more value out of Lightning Surge in many situations. You should always be
looking for opportunities to hit enemy Heroes with the center of the beam.
Playing a Lightning Surge Build is a good way to practice this
behavior, and can help you see opportunities to hit multiple enemies with each
cast.

abilities.title: Deadly Charge
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Deadly Charge
(R)
Alarak
Heroic
Cooldown: 45 seconds
After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds.
Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.
Deadly Charge can deal massive damage to several enemy Heroes, or deal
fatal damage to a low Health enemy who is fleeing a team fight. You will be
fully committed after your charge, so make sure your team is ready before you
charge in. If your team does not want to commit to a fight, you may cancel the
channel at any time. Attempting to
channel Deadly Charge while inside or
behind an enemy Minion wave will not work, as the Minions will attack you and
cancel your channel. Deadly Charge is more risky than Counter-Strike, because
its defensive uses are limited.
Deadly Charge can also be used by charging for only 0.3 seconds, being a good
follow up for your own combo without putting Alarak into a
dangerous situation, since the dash will be really short.

abilities.title: Counter-Strike
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Counter-Strike
(R)
Alarak
Heroic
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.
Counter-Strike is a great Heroic option that can be used to save Alarak from
high damage Abilities, hard crowd control,
or simply to deal burst damage
during a fight. When using Counter-Strike primarily as a damage source, enemy
damage over time effects will proc the strike very reliably. You will need to
think ahead and counter an enemy attack, which is much different than the hard
engage you get from Deadly Charge.

Ruthless Momentum (Level 1) Alarak Reduce the Mana cost of Telekinesis from 30 to 20. Telekinesis's cooldown recharges 100% faster while above 80% Health.

Extended Lightning (Level 1) Alarak Reduce Sadism by 10%. Quest: Hit Heroes with the center of Lightning Surge. Reward: After hitting 5 Heroes, increase Lightning Surge's range by 20%. Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Lightning Surge's center also Slows enemies by 40% for 2 seconds. Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with the center of a single cast, increase Sadism by 10% and instantly gain all other Rewards.

4.text: ✘︎ Chaos Reigns (Level 4) Alarak Quest: Hit Heroes with Discord Strike. Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, increase Discord Strike's damage by 60. Reward: After hitting 2 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 60. Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 100 and instantly gain all other Rewards.

Negatively Charged (Level 4) Alarak Increase the Lightning Surge damage bonus to enemies between Alarak and his victim to 175%. Repeatable Quest: Each Hero hit by the center of Lightning Surge permanently increases the damage bonus by 5%.

Show of Force (Level 4) Alarak Heroes hit with 3 of Alarak's Abilities within 2 seconds take an additional 61 (+4% per level) damage and increase Sadism by 2%, stacking up to 20%. Sadism gained from Show of Force is lost on death.

7.text: Dissonance (Level 7) Alarak Increase Discord Strike's Silence duration by 0.75 seconds.
Hindered Motion (Level 7) Alarak Telekinesis Slows enemies by 30% for 3 seconds.
Applied Force (Level 7) Alarak Reduce Sadism by 10%, but Telekinesis pushes 15% further and has 15% increased range.

10.text: Deadly Charge (Level 10) Alarak Cooldown: 45 seconds After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds. Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

Counter-Strike (Level 10) Alarak Mana: 50 Cooldown: 30 seconds Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.

13.text: Blade of the Highlord (Level 13) Alarak Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Sadism by 2% stacking up to 40%. Sadism gained from Blade of the Highlord is lost on death.
Pure Malice (Level 13) Alarak Increase Sadism by 10% any time an allied Hero dies, up to 40%. Sadism gained from Pure Malice is lost on death.

Rite of Rak'Shir (Level 13) Alarak Cooldown: 300 seconds Activate to mark an enemy Hero for 300 seconds. Hitting the marked Hero with Discord Strike increases Sadism by 3%. Killing the marked Hero increases Sadism by 5% and lowers the cooldown of Rite of Rak'Shir to 10 seconds. Sadism gained from Rite of Rak'Shir is lost on death.

16.text: Lethal Onslaught (Level 16) Alarak Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 50% of Sadism's damage bonus to Alarak's Basic Attacks for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh this duration.

Lightning Barrage (Level 16) Alarak Hitting an enemy Hero with the center of Lightning Surge allows it to be cast again for free on a different primary target within the next 3 seconds. This free cast cannot benefit from Lightning Barrage.

Mocking Strikes (Level 16) Alarak Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Alarak's Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds. This bonus is doubled against enemy Heroes who are Stunned, Silenced, Slowed, or Rooted.

20.text: Wrath of the Highlord (Level 20) Alarak Mana: 50 Cooldown: 30 seconds If Deadly Charge was the selected Heroic, Heroes hit by Deadly Charge take bonus damage from Alarak's Abilities equal to 75% of Sadism's bonus damage for 4 seconds. If Counter-Strike was the selected Heroic, its cooldown is reduced by 2.5 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by Alarak's Basic Abilities.

Might of the Highlord (Level 20) Alarak Cooldown: 0.5 seconds Alarak gains access to both of his Heroic Abilities. This can be activated to change which Ability occupies the Heroic slot, with the other Ability using the Trait slot.

Last Laugh (Level 20) Alarak Cooldown: 30 seconds Activate to teleport to the chosen location and remove all Roots, Slows, and damage over time effects. If Alarak fails to hit enemy Heroes 3 times with Basic Abilities within 4 seconds of using Last Laugh, his Health is reduced to 1.
Hasty Bargain (Level 20) Alarak Cooldown: 20 seconds Activate to permanently reduce Alarak's Sadism by 4% and reset the cooldowns of his Basic Abilities.

Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with the center of a single cast, increase Sadism by 10% and instantly gain all other Rewards.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Overwhelming Power will greatly increase Alarak's
damage output and self-sustain
as long as he keeps delivering Basic Attacks. This Talent also enables
Alarak to easily offlane against most Heroes, and is
a great option if you are facing a very resistant team composition. This Talent has
great Synergy with Lethal Onslaught and Mocking Strikes
at Level 16.
Ruthless Momentum can greatly reduce the cooldown of Telekinesis,
as long as you remain near full Health. This Talent will be at its best when
laning with allies during the early game, because your Healer can help to make
sure you stay near full Health.
Extended Lightning is made up of 3 Quests which enhance
Lightning Surge. The first Quest increases the range of Lightning Surge,
allowing you to poke from much safer positions. It will give
you more opportunities to find targets behind enemy Heroes, which will allow
you to stack other Lightning Surge-related Quests more easily. The additional
range will also allow you to heal with Lightning Surge more safely. This Quest
can usually be completed in the opening team fight, if there
is one. The second Quest adds a Slow to enemies hit by the center of Lightning
Surge. This can be very powerful in team fights and as a follow-up to
Telekinesis and Discord Strike. The aforementioned Slow can also be used to set up your combo,
as the Slowed enemies will be much easier to hit. The third Quest gives a 10%
Sadism bonus; this essentially refunds Extended Lightning's initial Sadism
penalty.

talent_pages.title: Level 4 Talents for Alarak
talent_pages.text:
✘︎
Chaos Reigns
(Level 4)
Alarak
Quest: Hit Heroes with Discord Strike.
Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, increase Discord Strike's damage by 60.
Reward: After hitting 2 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 60.
Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 100 and instantly gain all other Rewards.
?
Negatively Charged
(Level 4)
Alarak
Increase the Lightning Surge damage bonus to enemies between Alarak and his victim to 175%.
Repeatable Quest: Each Hero hit by the center of Lightning Surge permanently increases the damage bonus by 5%.
✓
Show of Force
(Level 4)
Alarak
Heroes hit with 3 of Alarak's Abilities within 2 seconds take an additional 61 (+4% per level) damage and increase Sadism by 2%, stacking up to 20%.
Sadism gained from Show of Force is lost on death.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Chaos Reigns is an underwhelming Talent that increases
Discord Strike's damage when various quests are completed. If you
do not complete all the 3 parts of the quest early in the game, it will be a bad Talent.
Show of Force will overshadow it in most scenarios, since
it is guaranteed damage, and will always be better in the
late game.
Negatively Charged can greatly increase your damage
in team fights when using a Lightning Surge poke focused playstyle. Make sure
to hit enemies between you and your target in order to get value. The bonus
damage only applies to Lightning Surge's center area, so it is best to pair
this Talent with Extended Lightning. This quest's stacks
are not lost if Alarak dies.
Show of Force Greatly increases Alarak's burst
damage and sadism. It will be good in all situations, so we recommend going for it
when you have Ruthless Momentum, because you will be able
to proc it more often.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Alarak
talent_pages.text:
?
Dissonance
(Level 7)
Alarak
Increase Discord Strike's Silence duration by 0.75 seconds.
✓
Hindered Motion
(Level 7)
Alarak
Telekinesis Slows enemies by 30% for 3 seconds.
?
Applied Force
(Level 7)
Alarak
Reduce Sadism by 10%, but Telekinesis pushes 15% further and has 15% increased range.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Dissonance increases the Silence duration of Discord Strike.
This can be useful for locking down Heroes who have escapes, as they will be
unable to cast them for an additional amount of time. This is especially
useful against Warriors, who usually need to cast Abilities to enhance their
survivability.
Hindered Motion adds a slow to Telekinesis, which allows
Alarak to keep delivering Basic Attacks on a Silenced target, having good synergy
with Overwhelming Power.
Applied Force greatly increases the impact of
Telekinesis, and makes landing the Telekinesis into Discord Strike combo much
easier. At the same time it increases the effects of the other uses of
Telekinesis, including peel and escape. This Talent generally has the greatest
impact of the Talents in this tier; it allows Alarak to displace enemies
out of position from a safer distance.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Alarak
talent_pages.text:
✓
Deadly Charge
(Level 10)
Alarak
Cooldown: 45 seconds
After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds.
Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.
?
Counter-Strike
(Level 10)
Alarak
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
Deadly Charge can deal massive damage to several enemy Heroes, or deal
fatal damage to a low Health enemy who is fleeing a team fight. You will be
fully committed after your charge, so make sure your team is ready before you
charge in. If your team does not want to commit to a fight, you may cancel the
channel at any time. Attempting to
channel Deadly Charge while inside or
behind an enemy Minion wave will not work, as the Minions will attack you and
cancel your channel. Deadly Charge is more risky than Counter Strike, because
its defensive uses are limited.
It can also be used by charging for only 0.3 seconds, being a good
follow up for your own combo without putting Alarak into a
dangerous situation, since the dash will be really short.
Counter-Strike is a great Heroic option that can be used to save Alarak from
high damage Abilities, hard crowd control,
or simply to deal burst damage
during a fight. When using Counter-Strike primarily as a damage source, enemy
damage over time effects will proc the strike very reliably. You will need to
think ahead and counter an enemy attack, which is much different than the hard
engage you get from Deadly Charge. It is generally recommended
over Deadly Charge due to the control and versatility it provides.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Alarak
talent_pages.text:
✓
Blade of the Highlord
(Level 13)
Alarak
Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Sadism by 2% stacking up to 40%.
Sadism gained from Blade of the Highlord is lost on death.
?
Pure Malice
(Level 13)
Alarak
Increase Sadism by 10% any time an allied Hero dies, up to 40%.
Sadism gained from Pure Malice is lost on death.
?
Rite of Rak'Shir
(Level 13)
Alarak
Cooldown: 300 seconds
Activate to mark an enemy Hero for 300 seconds.
Hitting the marked Hero with Discord Strike increases Sadism by 3%. Killing the marked Hero increases Sadism by 5% and lowers the cooldown of Rite of Rak'Shir to 10 seconds.
Sadism gained from Rite of Rak'Shir is lost on death.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Blade of the Highlord increases Sadism each time Alarak applies
Basic Attacks to enemy Heroes. This bonus is lost on death. The bonus Sadism
has a limit of 40%. This Talent forces Alarak into risking himself more, since he
has to land Basic Attacks. It can be a good choice if you want a fast sadism boost
for an upcoming important fight.
Pure Malice is the most reliable Talent available at Level 13,
requiring no special playstyle from Alarak. When he dies,
he loses all bonuses from every Talent on this tier. As soon as a game starts
going downhill, Alarak becomes a lot weaker: he is very strong when ahead,
but weak when behind. Pure Malice shores up his major weakness,
letting him gain sadism back to quickly regain control of the game.
Rite of Rak'Shir has the potential to scale
Sadism's bonus to absurd amounts. This bonus is lost
on death, but can otherwise be stacked without limit. You can gain 5% Sadism
easily, just by casting this on an enemy Hero who is about to die. Some enemies
will be zoned out of fights, simply by casting Rite of Rak'Shir on them. However,
this Talent is harder to get value from than the other options. Sometimes it will
be a wasted Talent, since the marked target can just avoid fighting Alarak until
it is extremely necessary.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Alarak
talent_pages.text:
✓
Lethal Onslaught
(Level 16)
Alarak
Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 50% of Sadism's damage bonus to Alarak's Basic Attacks for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh this duration.
?
Lightning Barrage
(Level 16)
Alarak
Hitting an enemy Hero with the center of Lightning Surge allows it to be cast again for free on a different primary target within the next 3 seconds. This free cast cannot benefit from Lightning Barrage.
?
Mocking Strikes
(Level 16)
Alarak
Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Alarak's Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds. This bonus is doubled against enemy Heroes who are Stunned, Silenced, Slowed, or Rooted.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Lethal Onslaught is similar to Mocking Strikes in
that they both grant a bonus to Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes who have
been hit by Discord Strike. Lethal Onslaught can only be triggered by Discord
Strike. However, Mocking Strikes can be triggered by any
Silence, Slow, Stun,
or Root effects. In addition to this important difference,
the effect of Mocking Strikes is much more powerful than that of Lethal
Onslaught. Lethal Onslaught does increase the amount of damage Alarak can
deliver in a single combo, which can help secure kills in some situations.
Lightning Barrage is a great Talent for playstyles focused on
Lightning Surge use. This enables you to deal more damage, heal more often, and
stack Negatively Charged higher. However, it will also be good
in other playstyles as well, since it will give you more damage
and self-sustain without
risking yourself with Basic attacks.
Mocking Strikes reduces Basic Ability cooldowns
each time Alarak Basic Attacks an enemy Hero. Stunned,
Silenced, Slowed, or Rooted
enemies will double this bonus.
Be aware that in some situations it might
not be safe to Basic Attack the target if you have no
Abilities ready in case enemies engage you. However, if you are able to use your
basic attacks often, this Talent will add much damage into your kit by reducing
your cooldowns. It also has a great synergy with Overwhelming Power
and Hindered Motion.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Alarak
talent_pages.text:
✓
Wrath of the Highlord
(Level 20)
Alarak
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 30 seconds
If Deadly Charge was the selected Heroic, Heroes hit by Deadly Charge take bonus damage from Alarak's Abilities equal to 75% of Sadism's bonus damage for 4 seconds.
If Counter-Strike was the selected Heroic, its cooldown is reduced by 2.5 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by Alarak's Basic Abilities.
?
Might of the Highlord
(Level 20)
Alarak
Cooldown: 0.5 seconds
Alarak gains access to both of his Heroic Abilities. This can be activated to change which Ability occupies the Heroic slot, with the other Ability using the Trait slot.
?
Last Laugh
(Level 20)
Alarak
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Activate to teleport to the chosen location and remove all Roots, Slows, and damage over time effects. If Alarak fails to hit enemy Heroes 3 times with Basic Abilities within 4 seconds of using Last Laugh, his Health is reduced to 1.
?
Hasty Bargain
(Level 20)
Alarak
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Activate to permanently reduce Alarak's Sadism by 4% and reset the cooldowns of his Basic Abilities.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Wrath of the Highlord significantly enhances Alarak's Heroic Abilities.
With Deadly Charge: To maximize this talent, Alarak should initiate
combat by charging in. After the initial engage, he should follow up
with his abilities for maximum damage. It is a great option for this tier.
With Counter-Strike: The cooldown reduction is most beneficial if used
early in a fight. However, it is often better to reserve Counter-Strike for blocking
impactful abilities from opponents, such as Pyroblast or to
block a strong crowd control Ability. Therefore,
it might be better to explore other options at this tier.
Might of the Highlord gives Alarak the Heroic ability
that he has not taken at Level 10. Due to how the other options greatly complement
Deadly Charge, this option is better when you have chosen
Counter-Strike, but can be used with any Heroic Ability.
Last Laugh is a risky Talent that is almost
exclusively useful as an escape. Attempting to use this Talent offensively
will often result in death, unless you are very confident in your ability to
reliably land Alarak's skillshots. As a last resort escape it can
be worth taking, as Telekinesis is a rather poor tool for a full retreat. If
you need something to preserve your extra Sadism stacks,
this Talent can often work. Last Laugh will also cleanse all
debuffs and damage over time affecting Alarak, being a decent
pick against Poison-reliant Heroes, such as Lunara or Xul
with Poison Nova.
Hasty Bargain gives up some of Sadism's bonus damage
with each use; however, it allows Alarak to kill most Heroes in the game by
himself. If you are confident and comfortable on Alarak, this Talent can allow
you to close out a late game team fight in order to secure victory. For
maximum value, throw out your full Ability rotation, then activate Hasty
Bargain and repeat. Do not worry about the damage you give up doing this, as
kills in the late game are much more valuable.
